svg.title: Trots Oudtshoorn colourful black T-shirt back
svg.desc: Large colourful back print with mountain sunrise, full brand name, and Local Loud Proud slogan. Intended garment colour: black. Transparent background. All lettering is vector geometry; no fonts or linked images.
